content: Merged PR #3 (ctx-0001/fix-ci-rustfmt-windows) via squash to main at 36d674eb0b24ad3b423ebd17212a740ac902bcd4. Root causes fixed: wrong ErrorClass path in bitty-ipc-auth test, cfg(test)-only PeerCredentials::new/VerifiedPeer::attested invisible to downstream crate tests (added test-support feature), rustfmt --all, and a latent broken doctest in bitty-ipc-mcp (referenced nonexistent bitty_ipc crate dependency, only surfaced on Windows CI's separate 'cargo test --workspace --locked' step which runs doctests). All CI checks green: Quality gates, MSRV 1.85, Linux/Windows/macOS check+test, actionlint, CodeQL, CodeRabbit (no actionable findings). No public API removed; ServeContext::with_granted/with_granted_session/issue_automation_bearer and bitty-ipc's own test-support feature untouched, preserving core's pin at 6841646.
